understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through all KA59 levels by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; a level is only won when all goals are simultaneously covered, and the full game is won after achieving WIN on the final level within the step budgets.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controls the currently selected piece (identified by player.id and player.position) using MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN, which attempt to shift it one 3-pixel cell in that direction on the grid. If a pushable object (e.g., a block) is directly adjacent in the move direction, the move can push it along; walls and boundaries can block movement or behave inconsistently, so actual results may differ from the heuristic movement.*_blocked hints (which only indicate adjacency, not guaranteed failure). When multiple selectable pieces exist, control is switched by CLICKing the exact pixel coordinates of the desired selectable (matching the coordinates shown in state/objects), after which movement commands apply to that newly selected piece.

understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through all KA59 levels by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; a level is only won when all goals are simultaneously covered, and the full game is won after achieving WIN on the final level within the step budgets.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controls the currently selected piece (identified by player.id and player.position) using MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN, which attempt to shift it one 3-pixel cell in that direction on the grid. If a pushable object (e.g., a block) is directly adjacent in the move direction, the move can push it along; walls and boundaries can block movement or behave inconsistently, so actual results may differ from the heuristic movement.*_blocked hints (which only indicate adjacency, not guaranteed failure). When multiple selectable pieces exist, control is switched by CLICKing the exact pixel coordinates of the desired selectable (matching the coordinates shown in state/objects), after which movement commands apply to that newly selected piece.
